dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - August 07, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
Mets Edge Pirates in Thrilling 6-4 Victory

In a back-and-forth matchup, the New York Mets emerged victorious over the Pittsburgh Pirates, 6-4. Marcus Semien led the charge for the Mets, going 1-for-4 with a three-run homer and three RBIs. On the mound, the Mets' staff effort was enough to secure the win, while Yohan Ramírez pitched 3.1 innings of scoreless relief, striking out four.

In other action, the Toronto Blue Jays edged the Philadelphia Phillies 5-4, with Josh Smith going 3-for-4 with a solo homer and one RBI for the Blue Jays. The Blue Jays' Lazaro Estrada picked up the win, while Tyler Rogers earned the save.

In a lopsided affair, the Boston Red Sox routed the Athletics 13-1, with Jarren Duran going 1-for-4 with a two-run homer for the Red Sox. Payton Tolle pitched a gem for the Red Sox, striking out 14 over six innings.

The Los Angeles Angels held off the Miami Marlins 4-3, with Nolan Schanuel going 1-for-3 with a two-run homer for the Angels. Tyler Phillips pitched four strong innings for the Angels, striking out four.

The Cleveland Guardians dominated the Chicago White Sox 8-2, with Angel Martínez going 2-for-5 with a two-run homer and six RBIs for the Guardians. Parker Messick pitched a complete game for the Guardians, striking out eight.

The Minnesota Twins edged the Milwaukee Brewers 8-6, with Josh Bell going 4-for-5 with a solo homer and three RBIs for the Twins. Zebby Matthews picked up the win for the Twins.

In other results, the Chicago Cubs beat the Kansas City Royals 6-4, with Pedro Ramírez going 2-for-4 with a solo homer and one RBI for the Cubs. Jacob Webb earned the save for the Cubs.
